notes:
- Cancelling or completing a trade now makes players leave party
- Marketplace UI improvements
- Existing listings can now be edited
- When selling an item, the maximum quantity is now the total amount possessed instead of the size of the selected stack
- Added a filter to hide your own listings in the Browse page
- When whispering a player about an item via the marketplace, the whisper will show the item's name in the right language for both the sender and receiver of the whisper
- Fixed an issue where item names were displayed in English when the game was set to another language
